dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "pytest"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for pytest (latest stable) and codeql (approximate latest version based on GitHub repo). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim, installs dependencies, and sets default command to run pytest based on detected imports.
